sources.label: Canada pilot pack.json and local integration

assumptions: The user requested local game integration and the existing LawScape palette.
All people and records are original fictional examples.
gaps: Canadian practitioner legal approval has not been obtained.
No French-language course, new maps, or continuing-matter engine is supplied in this pilot.

composition.shape: Review brief with a five-row curriculum table
composition.rationale: The equal five-question allocation and distinct email topics are most accurately compared in a table. Open narrative gives scope; two final cards distinguish limits and action. No spatial map suggests legal coverage outside the three provinces.

sections.purpose: Explain the completed test content and pending practitioner review.

claims.text: The pilot adds original fictional exercises for Ontario, British Columbia and Saskatchewan to local LawScape.
What should the Canadian practitioner review before a wider release?
All 25 proposed answer keys and five email rubrics. Source retrieval supports review; it does not constitute legal approval.
Five questions and one email cover each topic: Ontario representation, BC referrals, BC recording, Saskatchewan language rights, and BC commitments.
English-language pilot. No AI grading or real email. Canadian test answers do not change Ethics, gold or question tiers. Continuing matters and new maps remain future work.
Open review.html to inspect every option, source and sample reply. Mark proposed ready, revise or hold; export notes as Markdown or JSON. In LawScape, select Canada · TEST PACK.

popup.title: What the review package contains
popup.lede: Thirty original exercises, with a separate record of proposed reviewer decisions.

sections.heading: Inspect the complete content
sections.body: review.html shows every question, all four option explanations, five email prompts, fictional records, sample replies and human-review rubrics. QUESTIONS.md and EMAILS.md provide editable text copies. pack.json is the canonical curriculum source.

sections.heading: Trace the authorities
sections.body: SOURCES.md identifies five official primary sources, retrieval dates and version limitations. Each exercise cites rule locators. The local originals and hashes are retained in sources/. The LSO Rule 3 page was inaccessible and is not an authority for this pack.

sections.heading: Record a qualified decision
sections.body: The review page saves per-exercise decisions and notes in this browser and exports them as Markdown or JSON. Proposed ready is not release approval. The current pack remains unreviewed until the practitioner’s changes and legal sign-off are recorded.
